erin: Quick sync  planning a preflight run for the Snowflake + Databricks connector bundle ahead of marketplace listing. Scope: ingest correctness, metadata preservation, and listing packaging.

michael: Will validate Snowflake COPY and VARIANT edge-cases. Ill include nested arrays and multi-line JSON.

puneet: Ill run Databricks autoloader and Delta Share pulls into the Redwood staging topic. Will test schema evolution (add/rename/drop) and compaction races.

annah: Ill run vectorizer end-to-end to Pinecone + Qdrant and watch for metadata truncation and id collisions. Also check embedding dedupe for duplicate content.

integration-bot: Please create ticket RUN-2168-marketplace-preflight and attach test matrix template runbook.redwood/marketplace-preflight-template

erin: Acceptance checklist proposal:
- No connector 5xx on trimmed loads
- Metadata preserved to 4KB by default; truncation must produce WARN and attach repro
- Schema evolution should not drop rows (upserts allowed)
- Marketplace bundle includes install manifest and test harness samples

michael: Ill drop SQL payloads in the shared folder: https://go.redwood/sf-marketplace-preflight

puneet: Proposed run: Fri 09:00 PT, 2h window. Ill post job links and minimal repro snippets to the ticket.

erin: Ownership: michael (Snowflake), puneet (Databricks), annah (vectorizer), erin (coord + summary). If blockers show up earlier, ping @erin or drop repros in RUN-2168. :rocket:
